== Summary ==
Original Japanese printing of [[Grand Moff Tarkin (Japanese)]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)]]. Extracted unchanged from the original embedded JPEG on encyclopedia p. 41.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Source PDF SHA256: <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">07bb3a1fbdd1a65f6cafdff1fca821108ff8210c82da70a10b988ea7539d1665</code>. Embedded image xref: 2031. Original image SHA256: <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">f850af7b83bb52692690b1623abf6410b3018f373005678cb702bff9791e3345</code>. No resize, crop, retouching or reconstruction.

The card credits Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997. This image documents the historical printing.
